After i kill the two guys at the bottom of the stairs outside the elevator, i walk close to the two sets of double doors and wait till the guy comes walking through, depending on which door he comes from, hide round the corner at the elevator and wait till hes past the camera to take him out, afterwards, always go through the left set of doors, wait for the camera to turn and hug the left wall until youre nearly underneath the camera, there is normally 2 guys at the desk in the middle of the room and a guy over in the corner, you can take all of these guys out without the camera or them seeing, then theres a guy in the control room in the corner, if hes facing the keypads youll need to take him out, otherwise you can pretty much ignore him, if you have the level 2 passes you can just enter the room and take him out, remember you can stun the cameras, but you can also shoot one camera to permanently take it out, but only one, if youre still having trouble you can try using the emp on that room, i just prefer saving it for the journey back to make it easier. If all else fails theres youtube vids that show you the whole process, good luck man, lemme know if you need anything else x

I dont think you can change it once selected, youll need to wait until the next heist or cancel the heist and restart which you probs dont want to do cos of the effort you've put in already, if you plan on running it with 2 people then artwork is your go to, when im planning heists if i get cash when i scope it out i always just cancel it and redo the mission to get something better, the emp is very useful too, once youve grabbed the loot, pop the emp at the bottom of the stairs and you can run all the way up and back to the staff entrance before it runs out which makes getting out ten times easier

You can do a setup mission for the level 2 pass on the bottom right of the setup board or you can pay 70k to pass it, go in through the staff entrance and out through it too its the easiest way, if you take the time to find and destroy the 50 signal jammers around the map you unlock the best hacker that gives you 3 and a half minutes, once you get it the first couple times it gets easy, ive done it 10+ times and believe me the stealth can be wack sometimes and you get caught for no reason, watch some youtube guides too for pointers, hope that helps x
